Proposition
[Rescaling tangent and asymptotic cones] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0419 ↗ def:chow-iii-g20-tangent-cone ↗ def:chow-iii-g11-asymptotic-cone 1. appG:G.23,appG:G.25\group Metric cones

If a tangent cone $(T_pX,d_p)$ or asymptotic cone $(AX,d_{AX})$ exists, then $(T_pX,cd_p)$ or $(AX,cd_{AX})$ is isometric to the original cone for every $c>0$.
Proof

\sketch Replace the scaling sequence $\alpha _i$ by $c\alpha _i$ (or $\omega _i$ by $\omega _i/c$); the two definitions then differ only by the displayed global homothety.

□
